description: Source code for an OpenAPI Toolkit class that loads OpenAPI specifications, extracts server and endpoint information, and generates tools for API interaction, including schema validation with Zod.

classes.name: OpenAPIToolkit_Tools
classes.description: Implements INode; loads and processes OpenAPI specifications to generate API tools.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the toolkit, loads OpenAPI spec, and generates tools based on selected endpoints.

methods.name: loadOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI spec from URL or file, auto-detects format, and returns parsed object.

methods.name: listServers
methods.description: Lists available servers from the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: listEndpoints
methods.description: Lists available API endpoints from the OpenAPI spec.
